note:
R13 — observed structure of the stock NHL / AHL schedules per title: how many games each pair of teams plays as a function of
their group relationship (same division / same conference, other division / other conference), home-away balance per pair, games
per team, and whether one (k_div, k_conf, k_cross) integer rule reproduces every pair count. Observed data only — this is not a
generation algorithm; it records what the shipped tables contain so a generator can be judged against them.

Group relationship per team comes from the team table: NHL 12+ / PS4 `conferencegroup` / `divisiongroup` (global ids), NHL 08–11
local `conference` / `division` bits (per league). Slots are ranks by `index` within the league (handoff 12 §1.2). Read-only; anchors
only (+ the real NHL 20 install DB through the R6 helper).

Usage: python r13_schedule_structure.py <out.json>
